text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's leave the slope training as it 
is for now, and do pool training on 
Mondays and Thursdays..."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, our training menu really has changed 
since our Classic year, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"I've finally caught up to the other 
Umamusume. The ones with two or three 
wins, the ones who've won graded stakes."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...It's been a long road, hasn't it, Meek?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —One, two! One, two!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer's Creed: Keep a close eye on your 
Umamusume! Never forget you are partners 
running together!)

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
(Running alongside Umamusume... I must be 
someone who can run with them towards 
their dreams. No matter how inexperienced 
I am... or how anxious I feel...)

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. That girl, again—

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Happy Meek-san, are you feeling 
unwell?

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Then what's wrong? Everyone else has 
already moved on to the next routine, you 
know? Or did you want to try a different 
menu...?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...I missed the ride... ............I'm 
heading out..."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: (I'm always a step behind...)

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
(Still... she never gives up halfway. It 
might be slow, but she always sees it 
through to the end. Even if she's left 
behind... even if she has to stay late...)

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. I have to do my best too! Just 
like her—"

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Hah... hah... phew. ...Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Ah... It's not here...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: "...Um. Happy Meek-san?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Here... please take this, if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for the sudden intrusion. I 
really wanted... to speak with you, even 
if just for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...With me?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Because you have given me so, so 
very much encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Never giving up on what you decided to 
do. Persisting, pushing through at your 
own pace... That's what I saw in you."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"So, well... um, err. ...You are a 
wonderful Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
If—if you can ever forgive me...! I want 
to run alongside you!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Happy Meek-san... Would you... please 
become... my trainee Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
(I remember. The first time I saw Meek 
smile was definitely back then—)

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, a text? Who could it be at this 
hour...?"

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Apparently she collapsed beside the track. 
It seems she had built up quite a lot of 
fatigue.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"However, there don't appear to be any 
major issues, so you can rest easy for 
now. Please take care."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes... Thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Fatigue... ...Could it be because I didn't 
think her training through properly...? —

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
No, you're... wrong! ...No, that's not it. 
Trainer... I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though you told me... to go at my 
own pace... ...It's because... I was doing 
extra training..."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Independent training? B-But 
why...?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Bitter, and Glacé... and Ms. 
Kashimoto... They were... happy. ...So 
much... together.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
Win. ...Rejoice, together. ...Be happy... 
together.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"I want to, too"... is what I thought. 
...I wanted to celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
I wanted us... to find happiness together. 
...Together with you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
You were watching me... You understood 
me...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: With my... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I wanted to win. That's why. ...But.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ......I am sorry.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Meek...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
“—So that's the secret behind Meek-chan's 
rapid growth. To think she was putting in 
so much effort behind the scenes.”

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...I thought I was keeping a close eye on 
her. That I had to be the person who knew 
her better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...But I was completely blind to it. I was 
just so swept up in seeing how much she'd 
grown. Even though you went out of your 
way to warn me...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...Godolphin Arabian was calm and fully 
understood all the potential risks. She 
knows all the best training methods...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The best trainer for Meek isn't someone 
like me, but—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. Little Meek worked so 
hard to get this far not because of my 
watching over her or my knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
...Meek-chan did her best because you were 
her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Because I was... your Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
...Once upon a time, there was an 
Umamusume like this.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
A child whom no one expected anything 
from, whose own parents had given up on 
her running—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
My body was frail, and no one thought I 
could produce results. So I wasn't even 
given proper training. It took me nearly 
20 races just to get my first win.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Day after day of training where she wanted 
to win, yet had no chance of doing so. 
Gradually, it wore down her spirit.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
However, a certain Trainer paid a visit to 
her side.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
That Trainer stayed by her side through 
thick and thin, supporting her even when 
she was at her lowest.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that persistence got through to 
her, as the girl gradually opened up, and 
her race results began to change.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Before long, she even triumphed over the 
one hailed as the strongest Umamusume; 
forging an irreplaceable bond, the two 
etched their names into history.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Changing an Umamusume's feelings, and 
their future—that is what a Trainer does.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"And Bitter Glasse trusts you and holds 
you close to her heart. ...She said it 
herself, didn't she? That you watch over 
her and understand her?"

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Then there is no reason to hesitate. The 
best trainer for Meek-chan is you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...To Meek, the number one... ...gah.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...I want to live up to Meek's 
feelings...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
If she wants to do her best—if she wants 
to win quickly, then I want to support her 
with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you can do it. Running alongside them 
as their one and only Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ………… ...Happy Meek is...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
(The risks of overtraining... They really 
do happen for a reason.)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
(...I can't choose training that pushes me 
to my absolute limits...)
